theorems.name: Submission.chart_meanCurvature_eq_normalPart_gram_sum
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (y : Rn N) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N) (S : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N), Function.Injective A → tangentSpace M y = LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap → (∀ a b : Rn n, secondFundamentalForm M y (A a) (A b) = normalPart M y (S a b)) → meanCurvature M y = normalPart M y (∑ l : Fin n, S (EuclideanSpace.single l 1) (Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A ∘L A) (EuclideanSpace.single l 1)))
